parsed.description: Discard '0-10' run: it trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD, so the 1.0999 is likely contaminated val leakage. Reverted to shards 0-9; next test raises MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.10 on clean data.
parsed.report_to_operator: Potential train/eval overlap: prepare.py downloaded 11 shards (0-10) and EVAL_SHARD=10, so TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to include the validation shard. I discarded that run. Please confirm whether each shard has separate train/val splits — if the val split is held out within the shard, the extra data may be safely usable.
